input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets the preferred position in full: 19.1 gives a professional and workmanlike services warranty plus material conformity to documentation and specifications; 19.2 gives a 90-day Deliverable conformity warranty (measured from the later of delivery or acceptance) and conformity of hosted Services for the whole subscription term, which meets or exceeds the software benchmark; 19.3 adds no-malicious-code, compliance with Applicable Law and no-functionality-reduction warranties; 19.4 provides the required remedy ladder of prompt re-performance, repair or replacement and, failing that, termination with refund of Fees paid, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims; and 19.5 confirms no disclaimer limits an express warranty, so the implied-warranty disclaimer does not swallow the express warranties. Acceptance remedies at 6.1-6.2 reinforce this. No redline needed.
